title: Google\Cloud\Container\V1\MasterAuthorizedNetworksConfig
name: MasterAuthorizedNetworksConfig
description: Configuration options for the master authorized networks feature. Enabled master authorized networks will disallow all external traffic to access Kubernetes master through HTTPS except traffic from the given CIDR blocks, Google Compute Engine Public IPs and Google Prod IPs.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.enabled
params.description: Whether or not master authorized networks is enabled.

params.name: data.cidr_blocks
params.description: cidr_blocks define up to 50 external networks that could access Kubernetes master through HTTPS.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Whether or not master authorized networks is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Whether or not master authorized networks is enabled.

methods.name: getCidrBlocks
methods.description: cidr_blocks define up to 50 external networks that could access Kubernetes master through HTTPS.

methods.name: setCidrBlocks
methods.description: cidr_blocks define up to 50 external networks that could access Kubernetes master through HTTPS.
